title: GeoCircle
description:
A GeoCircle is a GeoShape representing a circular geographic area. As it is a GeoShape
          it provides the simple textual property 'circle', but also allows the combination of postalCode alongside geoRadius.
          The center of the circle can be indicated via the 'geoMidpoint' property, or more approximately using 'address', 'postalCode'.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

geoMidpoint.title: Geo Midpoint
geoMidpoint.description: Indicates the GeoCoordinates at the centre of a GeoShape, e.g. GeoCircle.

geoRadius.title: Geo Radius
geoRadius.description: Indicates the approximate radius of a GeoCircle (metres unless indicated otherwise via Distance notation).
